" DriverSpa-Admin is a mobile app for finding and booking the nearest car washes with the best service quality. No more queues! You can always find the closest available car wash and book a convenient time. And all of this is completely free for drivers!\nCompare car wash prices and ratings based on reviews from other DriverSpa-Admin users. We carefully monitor the quality of service provided to our users. In case of a complaint about staff performance, we review it together with the car wash management and take the necessary measures to prevent such cases from recurring. If a car wash receives numerous complaints, we remove it from our database.\nYour reviews will greatly help us develop and grow DriverSpa-Admin. We would be very grateful for a review in the app store."
